messages.subject: Re: qplot
parts:
That's not much information--I'm guessing a bit at what you want--but
basically you'll need to (i) reshape the data frame and (ii) plot it.
Something like this:

library( reshape )
d1 <- melt( d, id.vars=V1 ) # where d is the original d.f., and V1 is
gene column
library( ggplot2 )
qplot( as.factor( variable ), value, geom="line", data=d1, group=V1, color=V1 )

Is this what you were thinking of? If not please provide a better
description and reproducible dataset.

Ben

messages.subject: Re: qplot
parts:
Hi:

Is this what you had in mind??

gene1 <- rpois(15, 12)
gene2 <- rpois(15, 8)
gene3 <- rpois(15, 5)
gene4 <- rpois(15, 3)
DF <- data.frame(index = seq_len(15),
gene1, gene2, gene3, gene4)
library('reshape2')
library('ggplot2')
DFm <- melt(DF, id.var = 'index')
str(DFm)
ggplot(DFm, aes(x = index, y = value, color = variable)) +
geom_point() + geom_line(size = 1)

Dennis
